🚨12 HOUR NEWS RECAP

1.⁠ A desperate search is still underway for dozens of campers, including children, after devastating floods killed at least 51 in Texas. 4 girls missing from a summer camp were found dead and were among at least 15 children killed in what Texas Rep. Chip Roy called a “once-in-a-century flood.” 

2.⁠ ⁠Texas Gov. Abbott praised the heroic efforts of emergency responders to the flooding: “In 36 hours, they have rescued or recovered more than 850 people. Some were clinging to trees to save their lives.”

3.⁠ Trump said his new bill would strengthen the U.S: “The One Big Beautiful Bill will deliver the strongest border on Earth, the strongest economy on Earth, the strongest military on Earth, & ensure the United States of America will remain the strongest country anywhere on this beautiful planet of ours.”

4.⁠ Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi touched down in Rio for the BRICS summit, looking to cozy up to the club that’s trying to shake up the world order. With the U.S and EU giving Tehran the cold shoulder, Araqchi’s betting big on new friends.

5.⁠ China unlocked a 3rd flight path skimming the Taiwan Strait’s unofficial “no-go” line, and Taipei is not amused. Beijing claims it’s all about “safety” and “efficiency,” but critics say it’s a not-so-subtle power flex to tighten its grip on contested skies.  

6.⁠ Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis proposed the abolition of property taxes: “Just for being on your property, you've got to write a check to the government every year?"

7.⁠ Russia chalked up a 30% drop in war losses from May to June and the lowest monthly total since the war started. However, they also lost 14 planes in the same month, their worst air losses yet, thanks to Ukraine’s mass drone attack.

8.⁠ Lebanon’s Parliament Speaker Nabih Berri is navigating tense talks as foreign envoys demand sweeping changes to the country. Lebanon said it will deliver its response Monday to a U.S demand to disarm Hezbollah and push through economic and border reforms.

9.⁠ Japan is giving 6 Abukuma-class destroyers to the Philippines to help them push back against Chinese aggression in the South China Sea. The 2,000-ton ships come loaded with anti-ship missiles, torpedoes, and enough firepower to make Beijing sweat.

10.⁠ The NB.1.8.1 variant, nicknamed “razor throat” for its sharp, painful symptoms, is now the top COVID strain in the U.S, making up 43% of cases. It’s spreading fast, already found in 21 states, with symptoms like fever, sore throat, vomiting, and diarrhea.
